This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

This is a bail application U/S.483 of BNSS by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with Gunupur P.S. Case No. 278 of 2024 corresponding to T.R. Case No. 48 of 2024 pending in the file of learned ADJ-cum-PO, Special Court under POCSO Act, Rayagada, for commission of offences punishable U/Ss. 376(2)(n)/376(3) of the IPC r/w. Sec. 6 of POCSO Act, on the main allegation of committing rape and aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon the victim.

3. Heard, Mr. Biraja Prasanna Das, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. C. Mohanty, learned Additional Public Prosecutor in the matter and perused the record including the copy of deposition of the victim.
None appears for the informant despite being duly informed as apprised by the learned State counsel.

4. After having considered the rival submission and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offences as alleged against the petitioner vis-- vis the accusations sought to be brought against him and regard being had to the pre-trial detention of the petitioner in custody since 24.12.2024 with examination of the victim in the meantime and there being little apprehension of tampering of evidence of material witness like victim and she having not supported the prosecution allegation against the petitioner and keeping in view the inherent right of the accused to be presumed innocent until proven guilty at the trial, this Court without expressing any view on merits,
admits the petitioner to bail.

sentences.text: Hence, the bail application of the petitioner stands allowed and the petitioner is allowed to go on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty-five Thousand) only with one solvent surety for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin of the case on such terms and conditions as deem fit and proper by it.
6. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy of the order as per Rules.
